en: Black‑and‑white street view of a European residential neighborhood, showing a row of ornate late‑19th / early‑20th‑century townhouses with gabled roofs, stucco façades, and decorative window surrounds. The sidewalk is lined with young trees and wrought‑iron fences. A dirt or lightly paved road runs alongside, with people walking and children with strollers or carts in the foreground, and several horse‑drawn wagons further down the street. Utility poles line the road; there are no automobiles visible.
